# Consulting Services

Leverage our deep expertise to build your next-generation visualization tools. From complex diagramming editors to interactive data dashboards, we help you deliver high-quality applications in record time.

## Why work with us?

#### Expertise

We are experts in **React, Angular, Vue, Svelte, TypeScript, SVG, HTML canvas, diagramming** and **visualizations**. We know the ecosystem inside out.

#### Speed to Market

We can build your app quickly. Don't waste months reinventing the wheel when we have the components ready to go.

#### Full Ownership

You get **all the source code** for your app. No vendor lock-in, no hidden proprietary modules.

#### Documentation

You get full API documentation and an MCP package for any custom components we build for you, ensuring your team can easily work with and enhance what we have built.

### Included Development License

When you engage us for a project, you don't pay for a VisuallyJs development license —**it is included in the engagement**. You get the best-in-class tools and the experts who built them, all in one package.

## Engagement Lifecycle

1

#### Initial Contact

You contact us with your project details and requirements using the form on this page.

2

#### Discovery Call

We get on a call to discuss your vision, technical requirements, and timeline.

3

#### Proposal

We propose a tailored engagement plan that fits your budget and goals.

4

#### Kickoff

If the proposal is acceptable, we start work immediately to bring your application to life.

5

#### Ongoing

We'll setup a Github repository to share our work and provide you with regular updates.
